svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The four sweeps of the L20 Lab. Step 7: E1 to E8 lit, Nd 112 mm, a narrow beam with three sidelobe pairs. Step 8: E3 to E6, Nd 56 mm, a beam twice as wide. Step 9: E4 and E5, Nd 28 mm, one broad lobe with no null. Step 10: E1 and E8, 98 mm apart, a narrow lobe repeated at full height. Each thumbnail is the array factor at 10.3 GHz in dBc, clipped at the noise floor.
